Name: DC Workhouse and Reformatory Historic District

Notes: The brewery takes its name from local legend: a patient from an insane asylum, being transferred to the Lorton workhouse, is said to have escaped into the nearby woods dressed in a bunny costume — becoming known ever after as “The Bunnyman.”
